title: Add a --json flag to a CLI
prompt: stats.js is a small CLI: `node stats.js 3 1 4 1 5` prints the count, mean, min and max. Add a --json flag (anywhere in the arguments) that prints the same numbers as a single JSON object with keys count, mean, min, max instead. The plain output must not change. With no numbers it should print an error to stderr and exit with code 1.
